[quote=skullsbrough;60259869][b]An Invitiation[/b]

Outside the central palace at a table, Admiral Vivian and Prime Minister Romain looked down at the letter they had just been handed

"So...are we really going to this?" Admiral Vivian asked the "Prime Minister" 

Romain simply looked confused at the question "Do we have a choice?"

"I seriously doubt it. We wouldn't want to risk our already very tenacious position by refusing. It could be taken as an insult," responded Vivian, looking back down at the letter.

"The bigger question, I guess, is whether the royals are going to accept this? They haven't been the most talkative since we've left Komend." 

"Eh...does it matter what they think? Seriously. We seriously aren't going let them being angsty ruin this for us."

Romain looked at Vivian surprised, "They lost their parents, Vivian. I know they haven't been the most cooperative, but give them a break."

"Anyway..." The admiral trying to change the subject

"I'll radio the royal guards to go get them down for us. You go get a cab and make sure you tell the Vespurian Embassy we would be happy to accept their request."

"Whatever. I'll be back soon, Admiral."

As the prime minister leaves, grabbing a piece of paper and an envelope embossed with the Royal and Government Seals of the Kingdom, the Admiral radios the royal guards to inform the royals to get ready in their proper uniforms.
_______________________________________________________________________

"What?!" 

Gaberial yelled out loud after the royal guard had left the room

"Okay wait hang on a f*cking second...I didn't agree to this. I told the admiral. I'm done. I don't want the throne, and I most certainly don't want to leave this guarded palace to get on some plane or boat where im just going to be hunted by some revolutionari-"

"Gabe, please shut up. You're going to wake up anne at this rate. She needs sleep. We haven't had alot of it." [Maximilien says quietly, gabe grumbles a bit before speaking again, more composed

"Look, Max, all I'm saying is that, you know. Lying low is usually done quietly. I don't even really consider myself a prince anymore. And unlike you two, I'm an adult."

Maximilien rolls his eyes "I get it but...like us, your also not in any position to refuse what the admiral wants. If he wants us to dance for him in front of the Vespurians...then I guess we got to do just that."

Gabe sighs and looks and looks at the stack of Thrømm cash on the counter

"Eh. I guess you have a point...for once anyway. We're getting new phones, though. And I'm going to get myself some wine...they better have some good sh*t here... I'm going to need it." Gaberial says, walking over and grabbing around 3000 Lyr 

"Oh, really? Get me some."

"F*ck off, max."

From: Prime Minister, Romain Feltgen

Adressed to: Imperial Court of Vespurias and Grand Princess Mary

On behalf of His Majesty's Government of Floueschia and the House of Zeveden

We would like to formally accept both the Imperial Court of Vespurias's invitation to the City of Hyperion and Grand Princess Mary's invitation of the Admiral to the city of Kingsmount. We also graciously thank both parties for the opportunity and their willingness to host us despite the current situation concerning our status as the legitimate, but exiled, government of the Confederate Kingdom of Floueschia. We will be arriving shortly after this message arrives to you.

With grace, Prime Minister Romain Feltgen[/quote]
THE EXILES

"...Rom...ain...Geltgen-" Jim wrote down on a paper.

"[i]F[/i]eltgen, Imperial Steward." Humphrey corrected calmly.

"Oh yes, quite right. Anyways, what are we going to do? Do I meet with the PM, the royals with our imperials, and the Admiral with the bitch- I mean, the witch- I mean the Grand Princess Mary?" Jim asked, removing his glasses and only floundering two times in a row.

"Yes, that would be optimal. You can take the PM to a more cordial and official meeting here in Hyperion whilst we try and make sure our imperials don't look any more provincial than they already are." Humphrey said as Bernard wrote that down.

"Let's say, an afternoon here, lunch with their Prime Minister, and the Imperials can have something done outdoors, and let's have The Grand Princess handle her own meeting with the admiral." Humphrey planned out as he stood up, and Bernard wrote it down.

"Would it be wise or even permitted for the Grand Princess to handle the Admiral without ministerial oversight?" Bernard asked as he got the minutes down.

"I'd like to see you try and tell that woman [i]no[/i], in fact, the better if she has little reason to leave Kingsmount at all!" The Imperial Steward said, "So we're all set and such, then?"

"Right you are, Imperial Minister." Humphrey politely bowed his head, thankful the little visit had taken Hacker's mind off policy, letting it be rightfully handled by the Civil Service.

«★»

The Vespurian Imperial Embassy would deliver a few notes before their departure for them to be aware of. There are no fuel or any such fuel-based transports in Hyperion, no plane or air traffic permitted in its vicinity. There is a city North of Hyperion, Darlene, just halfway from Hyperion and Hearth, the latter of which is was the former capital of the Commonwealth of Hithers, also known formerly as the Hitherlands, a hilly region.

It is recommended to either take a land transport from that city to an outpost by the Imperial Center or otherwise use a teleportation station, whichever choice is most preferable, and of which the Crown will ensure the best quality and security of, assuming a plane is taken to Darlene, otherwise the closest port to the Elseyrian coast is the capital of Norrhollow Principality, which has a straight road or otherwise luxury train work leading towards a city Northeast of Hyperion known as Cornbridge by the Albic River. As for the Grand Princess' invitation of the Admiral, a plane or ship to Kingsmount would suffice. The Imperial Crown will both pay for all transports and would be most hopeful tor personally transport the Prime Minister, Royals and Admiral.

Upon arrival it is to be noted that the Prime Minister is invited to a personal lunch with the Imperial Steward and his Head of Civil Service for official discussions, plus an extra, whilst the Admiral is invited to do likewise with the Grand Princess and her family alongside a later more official meeting in her estate, meanwhile the Royal Family is invited to the Grand Imperial Estate which surrounds the great park area of the White Tree of Hyperion, for an open lunch outside with the Imperial Family of which the Emperor, Empress, Crown Prince, Crown Princess Consort, Imperial Prince & Heir alongside his sister the Imperial Princess will be in attendance.

Gifts, offers, and comforts have been prepared.
